verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference runtime with OpenAI-compatible APIs, so concurrent-request capacity is a fair axis to ask about. Nothing in the pack documents reserved capacity, concurrency handling, or steady throughput across multiple agents or sessions. The 'reserve' call in the API docs is a file-upload step, and the plan limits in billing are a different feature; neither is runtime capacity reservation.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know the runtime reserves dedicated capacity so throughput holds steady when multiple agents or sessions issue requests concurrently
